BL-1759 — A launch never leaves a pane blocked or dead on Claude Code's first-run trust dialog - before starting any pane of a pack with a claude seat, the launch checks read-only that Claude Code trusts the target root or an ancestor, and if not starts nothing and names the root and the one step that trusts it; a pack with no claude seat is not checked, an unparseable Claude config warns and never blocks, and the launch never writes Claude Code's own config (ruling A, recommended)
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: New feature file and one real choice: how a launch deals with Claude Code's trust dialog on a directory it has never seen. Found at mint (read-only, trust flags only): this host's ~/.claude.json trusts /home/carillon/swarmforgevc and /home/carillon/gpu-bargain-hunter and none of their .worktrees pa…
